body:
This PR aims to add functions to generate the conformal cubed sphere grid described by Rančić et al. (1996).

Not complete yet (there's a bug somewhere...) but opening for help debugging.

![image (10)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20099589/109320549-1e70e800-781e-11eb-83b4-15df5667ec69.png)

Also ended up with a function to visualize complex mappings:

![image (9)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20099589/109320527-19ac3400-781e-11eb-863d-3773d13cc701.png)
title: Rančić et al. (1996) conformal cubed sphere
